subject: General Knowledge
description: State → capital pairs, including tricky recent UTs

questions.explanation: Sikkim — Gangtok. India's 22nd state (1975). Shillong = Meghalaya. Kohima = Nagaland. Imphal = Manipur. Dispur = Assam (not Guwahati).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the STATE with its CAPITAL. A. Jharkhand.  B. Chhattisgarh.  C. Uttarakhand.  D. Telangana. List-II: 1. Ranchi.  2. Raipur.  3. Dehradun.  4. Hyderabad.
questions.explanation: Four states formed this millennium: Jharkhand (2000, from Bihar) — Ranchi. Chhattisgarh (2000, from MP) — Raipur. Uttarakhand (2000, from UP) — Dehradun. Telangana (2014, from AP) — Hyderabad (shared with AP for up to 10 years).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The capital of ANDHRA PRADESH (post-bifurcation) is:
questions.explanation: Post-2014 bifurcation: Hyderabad was shared capital up to 10 years. Amaravati (near Vijayawada) was designated new AP capital. 2020: proposed 3 capital arrangement (Amaravati — legislative, Visakhapatnam — executive, Kurnool — judicial) — challenged in courts; situation remains fluid. Vijayawada is the largest city near Amaravati.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The state TRIPURA has which capital?
questions.explanation: Tripura — Agartala. Other NE state capitals: Aizawl (Mizoram), Itanagar (Arunachal Pradesh), Shillong (Meghalaya), Kohima (Nagaland), Imphal (Manipur), Dispur (Assam), Gangtok (Sikkim).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: After the August 2019 reorganisation, the union territory of LADAKH has which de-facto administrative centre?
questions.explanation: Ladakh UT created 31 October 2019 (along with J&K UT). Two districts — Leh + Kargil. Leh serves as the main administrative + tourism hub. Ladakh has no legislature (UT without legislature). Srinagar + Jammu are the dual capitals of the J&K UT. and Kargil, both headquarters of respective districts.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

_fixes.was: Leh (and Kargil, both headquarters of respective districts)

questions.stem: Which state has DISPUR (not Guwahati) as its official capital?
questions.explanation: Assam — capital is DISPUR (a locality within Guwahati). Common trap — many say Guwahati (the larger city). Dispur houses the Assam Secretariat. Designated capital since the separation of Shillong (then the capital) when Meghalaya was formed in 1972.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: GOA, India's smallest state by area, has its capital at:
questions.explanation: Panaji (Panjim) — capital of Goa, on the banks of the Mandovi river. Goa was Portuguese territory until 1961 (Operation Vijay). Became full state in 1987. Goa — smallest state by area (3,702 km²); Sikkim — 2nd smallest by area but smallest by population.
